purpose: Machine-readable memory for the candidate-v3 data refresh, Stage1-A-only formal training, and GRPO-Open versus GRPO-Exec reward-domain comparison.

research_objective.primary_question: Does execution-domain feedback from a frozen chassis execution surrogate improve GRPO refinement of a BEV-only platoon diffusion planner over command-trajectory open-loop GRPO?
research_objective.paper_focus: Dual-domain fusion between the planning command domain and the chassis execution domain.
excluded_legacy_mainlines: Stage 1 Variant A versus Variant B as a main experiment
four-model A/B Stage 1 and A/B GRPO matrix

historical_formal_dataset_v1.preservation_policy: Preserve as historical evidence. Do not relabel, overwrite, resume, or mix it with candidate-v3 data.

scenario_precondition.gate: User-authorized 10k diagnostic collection starts after the candidate-v3 S7 and S9 fixed-seed implementation gates pass. Remaining S5, S6, S8 and combined-contract acceptance remain mandatory before merge, formal-50k reuse, or training eligibility.
scenario_precondition.output: one collection-time candidate-v3 scenario contract hash; formal contract activation remains pending the all-scenario combined gate

pilot.name: candidate-v3 balanced quality pilot
pilot.scale_rationale: User-authorized 10k diagnostic quality collection after the S7 and S9 candidate-v3 gates; use 20 percent of the formal target with balanced 2k quotas so per-scenario and per-role behavior, following-gap, TTC, and unlock fractions are more stable than the previous 1k and planned 5k pilots.

quality_gate.threshold_policy: Freeze exact numeric thresholds and confidence-interval handling before pilot collection. Do not tune thresholds after seeing pilot results.

integrity_and_coverage: complete base and actor-sidecar scans, schema, shape, dtype, finite-value, join, fingerprint, and unfinished-transaction checks
exact 10000-joint-sample quota per S5-S9 scenario, at least 50 unique-seed base episodes per scenario, and at most 200 persisted joint samples from any one episode
train, validation, and test must each contain at least one committed base episode from every S5-S9 scenario
every scenario must cover fixed seeds 17, 23, 31, 47, and 59; incidental-background counts 3, 4, 5, and 6; and its frozen required behavior categories
all declared primary and exactly 3-6 incidental actors realized and persisted in every episode
safety: collision, out-of-road, background 5 m gap violation, and platoon-pair 7 m gap violation rates by scenario and role
minimum TTC and TTC quantiles by ego role and actor class
designated conflict-actor TTC evaluated against scenario-specific sampled ranges; incidental-background TTC evaluated separately
hard TTC below 0.5 s is a zero-tolerance safety violation unless an authoritative scenario contract explicitly defines a different measurement semantics
formation_following: actual leader-middle and middle-rear bumper gaps and desired-gap error quantiles while LOCKED
locked follower desired-gap absolute error P95 must not exceed the frozen 1.5 m controller-quality gate
formation release magnitude, recovery time, recovered gap error, platoon order preservation, and recovery persistence while UNLOCKED and after relock
per_vehicle_behavior: leader, middle, and rear KEEP/LEFT/RIGHT/STOP mode counts and fractions per scenario
speed, acceleration, jerk, lane-transition direction and completion-time distributions per role
scenario-required behavior-class coverage, including S5 response diversity, S6 target-gap coverage, S7 pass/yield coverage, S8 split-actor order diversity, and S9 bypass completion
unlock_state: LOCKED and UNLOCKED step counts and fractions globally, per scenario, per episode, and per ego role
unlock trigger rate, trigger cause, continuous unlocked duration, relock rate, and relock latency
zero unexpected unlock outside declared hazards and non-zero unlock coverage in every scenario whose contract requires formation release
distribution_and_training_usability: GT mode distribution and valid-mode rate globally, per scenario, and per role
speed, stop, low-speed, terminal displacement, progress, and expert-trajectory distributions
duplicate, missing, corrupt, NaN/Inf, leakage, scenario imbalance, role imbalance, and unobserved-mode checks

quality_gate.decision: Every hard gate must pass and all soft distribution risks must be reviewed and explicitly accepted before merge. A failed pilot returns to scenario, expert-policy, collector, or metric implementation without merging or starting 50k collection.

required_before_merge: 10k diagnostic quality collection complete with immutable fingerprints
repository tests and git diff check passed
no active collection or training process
merge_gate.post_merge_requirement: Record the BEV merge commit and re-run a short exact-path smoke from the merged tree before formal collection. The pre-merge 10k diagnostic samples are not reused in formal 50k.

new_formal_dataset.name: candidate-v3 formal S5-S9 50k

diversity_contract.enforcement: The collector persists formal_coverage metadata, caps and schedules episodes during collection, then performs a complete on-disk postcondition scan. The quality audit must be invoked with the same formal collection config and all formal_* gates must pass. Sample quota alone is insufficient.

new_formal_dataset.collection_policy: Collect into the named new empty root from the clean merged BEV commit using the frozen candidate-v3 formal50k config. Resume is allowed only for this new root with exact fingerprint and diversity metadata agreement. Do not append, copy, relabel, or mix samples from the historical v1 dataset or the 10k diagnostic collection. Reaching 50000 samples is not completion unless every diversity postcondition passes.

temporary_exploratory_training_waiver.purpose: Prepare and later exercise the Stage1-A training path before formal dataset acceptance is complete.

tau_d.name: raw diffusion trajectory
tau_d.role: Policy sample used for DDIM transition log-probability and the GRPO policy update. It is never replaced by the optimized or executed trajectory in the probability ratio.

tau_cmd.name: executable command trajectory
tau_cmd.role: The trajectory sent to the controller and the only trajectory input accepted by the chassis execution surrogate.

tau_a.name: predicted actual executed trajectory
tau_a.producer: frozen chassis execution surrogate(tau_cmd, initial_state, vehicle_condition, controller_context)
tau_a.role: The execution-domain state trajectory used by GRPO-Exec reward evaluation.

stage1.name: Formal BEV-only diffusion pretraining
stage1.predecessor_condition: candidate_v3_data_refresh.new_formal_dataset must be complete, fully verified, quality accepted, fingerprinted, and eligible_for_formal_training=true
stage1.initialization: ResNet18.a1 pretrained backbone plus newly initialized BEV planner modules
stage1.trainable_modules: all planner parameters, with the existing separate backbone and planner learning rates

variant_b_policy.status: retained only as historical implementation evidence; not part of the revised paper mainline

hard_gate: checkpoint must bind the formal base dataset fingerprint
train, validation, and test splits must retain the frozen episode split
best checkpoint selection uses validation only
checkpoint must pass strict reload, finite-loss, finite-gradient, open-loop, and S5-S9 closed-loop smoke gates
stage1.output: one eligible Stage1-A checkpoint shared by both Stage 2 branches

stage2_common_contract.name: Formal joint GRPO refinement
stage2_common_contract.source_checkpoint: the same frozen eligible Stage1-A checkpoint
stage2_common_contract.policy_probability: raw diffusion/DDIM rollout and sampled-mode log-probability
stage2_common_contract.optimizer_semantics: one optimizer step per joint group; no sequential-role optimizer and no PPO multi-epoch replay
stage2_common_contract.environment_semantics: The G candidates are never stepped as G MetaDrive branches. After scoring, select the best tau_cmd and call MetaDrive env.step() exactly once to obtain the next online scene state.
fairness_constants: optimizer, learning rate, KL and BC weights
reward component definitions and safety gates
online action selection and single env.step semantics

grpo_open.reward_definition: R_open = R(tau_cmd) using the current command-trajectory geometric and safety proxy

grpo_exec.reward_definition: R_exec = R(tau_a) using the frozen chassis execution surrogate prediction and the same reward semantics evaluated in the execution domain
surrogate_runtime_contract: surrogate input is tau_cmd, never tau_d
surrogate parameters are frozen and inference-only during GRPO
reward does not backpropagate through the surrogate
GRPO gradients come from the raw tau_d rollout log-probability ratio
surrogate failure is a typed error; no fallback to GRPO-Open reward

chassis_surrogate_formal_gate.synthetic_data_policy: Synthetic CF data may validate engineering interfaces, training convergence code, checkpointing, and visualization only. It cannot support formal GRPO-Exec training or paper conclusions.
required_before_formal_grpo_exec: real Windows TruckSim run bundles pass the frozen CF-2 export validator without filled-zero or inferred mandatory signals
run-group atomic split has no train/validation/test leakage
three-member ensemble training converges with finite loss
trajectory and chassis-state errors pass frozen ID gates
uncertainty calibration and OOD detection pass frozen gates
the selected surrogate checkpoint is immutable and its data, controller, optimizer, TruckSim project, and signal-map hashes are recorded

main_comparisons: Stage1-A versus GRPO-Open: benefit of Stage 2 open-loop refinement
GRPO-Open versus GRPO-Exec: benefit of execution-domain feedback
Stage1-A versus GRPO-Exec: end-to-end benefit of the complete dual-domain method
formal_evaluation.scenario_scope: multi-seed S5-S9 using identical episode manifests and model-noise seeds
metric_groups: formation error, maximum formation spread, and recovery time
acceleration, jerk, yaw rate, and steering change
trajectory optimizer intervention and final execution feasibility
BEV build, model inference, optimizer/surrogate, control mapping, and full planning tick P50/P95 latency
formal_evaluation.latency_gate: three-vehicle online planning remains within the frozen 100 ms P95 target unless a separately approved protocol revision records otherwise
formal_evaluation.optional_secondary_ablation: Inside GRPO-Exec only, compare surrogate ensemble mean against mean plus uncertainty-aware reward after the three-model main matrix is complete. This is not a Stage1 A/B ablation.

execution_order.action: Use the completed candidate-v3 S7 and S9 fixed-five-seed gates as the user-authorized trigger for an isolated diagnostic collection; bind the run to the exact collection-time candidate-v3 scenario hash.
Freeze the candidate-v3 10k diagnostic config, balanced 2k-per-scenario quotas, split seed, collection seed, per-scenario horizons, and isolated output root.
Collect the balanced 10k diagnostic dataset with 2k joint steps per S5-S9 scenario.

Run complete Diffusion and RiskEntry verification on the 10k dataset and record immutable fingerprints; then complete the frozen data-quality audit covering formation following gaps, TTC, per-vehicle behavior, unlock-state fractions, safety, coverage, and training usability.

Complete the remaining candidate-v3 S5, S6, S8 and combined-contract acceptance. Only after those gates and the 10k quality gate pass, merge s5-s9-scenario-revision into BEV, record the merge commit, and pass a post-merge exact-path smoke.
From the clean merged BEV commit, collect a new balanced candidate-v3 S5-S9 50k dataset into a new root.
Run both complete verifiers and the same quality audit on the new 50k dataset, then freeze its contract hash, fingerprints, bundle index, and formal-training eligibility.
Train and qualify one formal Stage1-A checkpoint on the newly frozen candidate-v3 50k dataset.
Freeze the common Stage 2 manifest, including source checkpoint hash, dataset fingerprints, scenario seeds, rollout noise seeds, update budget, reward config, and optimizer config.
Calibrate and formally train GRPO-Open from the frozen Stage1-A checkpoint.
Complete the real TruckSim surrogate data, fit, ID/OOD, and probability-calibration gates.
Calibrate and formally train GRPO-Exec from the same Stage1-A checkpoint and Stage 2 manifest.
Freeze both Stage 2 branches and run paired short smoke evaluation.
Perform semantic-preserving Round 14 cleanup only after both branches are stable; rerun all strict checkpoint and smoke gates after cleanup.
Run the final multi-seed S5-S9 three-model evaluation and produce the main comparison, optional surrogate ablation, latency, and failure-analysis reports.

stop_conditions: Do not start the user-authorized candidate-v3 10k collection before the S7 and S9 fixed-five-seed gates, collection-time scenario hash binding, and exact-path smoke pass.

Do not treat the 10k diagnostic dataset as formal or training-eligible, and do not merge into BEV or start the new 50k collection, unless the remaining S5, S6, S8 and combined-contract gates plus both complete verifiers and the pre-frozen quality gate pass.
Do not reuse 10k diagnostic samples in the formal 50k root, and do not mix candidate-v3 samples with the historical v1 dataset.
Do not change scenario, expert-policy, collector, schema, split, or quality-threshold semantics while pilot or formal collection is running.
Do not start formal Stage1-A until the new candidate-v3 50k dataset is complete, fully verified, quality accepted, fingerprinted, and eligible.

The temporary waiver permits only Stage1-A run_mode=smoke on the named 9999-sample dataset; every resulting checkpoint must remain diagnostic_only=true and ineligible for formal GRPO, formal evaluation, or paper evidence.
Do not start formal GRPO before the Stage1-A checkpoint is eligible.
Do not start formal GRPO-Exec with a synthetic-only surrogate.
Do not compare branches whose source checkpoint, seeds, budget, reward semantics, or trajectory optimizer differ.
Do not convert diagnostic artifacts into formal artifacts by editing metadata.
Do not perform Round 14 cleanup while either Stage 2 branch is still changing semantically.
Do not restore the obsolete Stage1 A/B or selector/MAPPO main experiment matrix without an explicit research-plan revision.
